tips.text: Buy the blueprints from Amir with Hex standing instead of farming the drops; a couple of days of standing covers the set.
If you only buy one piece, buy the main blueprint; it is the real wall on the drop route.
If you farm the parts anyway, run Hell-Scrub, not Legacyte Harvest; Techrot and Scaldra are about equal.
Collect every Hex Treasure on Höllvania missions and turn them in later; they glow bright green and make a loud buzz.
Run Steel Path bounties for roughly double the standing; three top-tier ones can reach the daily cap.
Players call Hex standing one of the fastest syndicate grinds; Rank 3 is a few days at the daily cap.
